comments.body: amterp asked for the same thing, Chat Notes 2026-10-12: "compact plus message after in one command".

creator: Alexander Terp
description: From tooling feedback, 2026-10-14, 0.16.0, a Claude Code pane on the devenv. Asked to compact itself and then carry on with its task, an agent ran `muster pane compact <focus>` with no `--pane`, as docs/cli/agents.md documents. The compaction ran once its turn ended, then nothing started another turn, so the task sat until a person typed. A message to itself is refused: `muster msg post --to "$MUSTER_PANE" ...` gives "a post cannot be addressed to its own author". The agent fell back to a harness timer a few minutes out, which races the compaction for the idle prompt. Something like `muster pane compact <focus> --then <prompt>`, typed like a ring once the compaction finishes, would close the gap. So would a self-addressed post that rings only after a queued compaction. Either way, "Compacting an agent" in docs/cli/agents.md could then say how an agent compacts and continues. Related: a_2YSLgi7gs.
title: A self-compacted agent stops until somebody types, and cannot post itself a message to carry on
